jobs.description:
Did you know that Sweden's largest shipyard for ship repair and conversion projects is in Landskrona? At Oresund DryDocks, vessels from across Northern Europe and beyond come to us for complex repair, maintenance and conversion projects. With a strong reputation for quality, safety and delivery performance, we are a leading player in the maritime industry.
Our success is built on the expertise and commitment of approximately 110 employees, working across project management, engineering, production and support functions. 
We are now looking for a Head of Production to lead and further develop our production organization.
The Role as Head of Production
As Head of Production, you will have overall responsibility for leading, developing and optimizing the production organization through your department managers within Steel, Piping, Mechanical, and Dock & Transport.
You will ensure that the organization has the right resources, competencies, processes and working methods in place to successfully deliver projects according to established targets for safety, quality, cost efficiency and delivery performance.
As a member of the management team, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and contributing to the company's long-term strategic development. The position requires a visible and engaged leadership style, with a strong presence in the business and close collaboration with employees, customers and stakeholders.
Experience
You have several years of experience in a senior production leadership role within the maritime, shipyard, manufacturing or other project-driven industrial sectors.
You have a proven track record of:

Leading managers and larger production organizations through delegated responsibility

Driving operational performance and achieving demanding business objectives

Developing organizations, processes and working methods to improve efficiency, productivity and delivery precision

Building and strengthening a proactive safety culture with a strong focus on HSEQ

Managing operations in an international business environment

Experience from project-driven production environments where flexibility, coordination and customer focus are critical is highly valued.
Leadership Profile
You are a confident and inspiring leader who leads by example. Through clear communication and a structured approach, you create engagement, accountability and commitment throughout the organization.
You are results-oriented and combine a strong business mindset with a genuine interest in people development. You can balance strategic thinking with operational execution and are comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment.
To succeed in the role, you should have:

Strong leadership and people management skills

Excellent planning and organizational abilities

A strong focus on quality, safety and customer satisfaction

Good technical understanding and the ability to translate business objectives into operational activities

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, written and spoken

Meritorious Qualifications

Experience from the shipbuilding, ship repair or maritime industry

Experience in Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement

What We Offer
At Oresund DryDocks, you will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team operating within an exciting international industry.
We offer a challenging and varied leadership role with significant opportunities to influence both operational performance and the future development of the company. Our organization is characterized by short decision-making paths, a collaborative culture and a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
You will work alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds who share a passion for delivering high-quality solutions to our customers. We believe that every employee contributes to our success and we actively support both personal and professional development.
As our business continues to grow, new opportunities and challenges arise every day. We therefore seek a leader who enjoys being present in the operation, building trust with employees, customers and subcontractors, and creating the conditions for long-term success.
To learn more about us, please visit www.oddab.eu
Application
We welcome your application through CV upload or LinkedIn profile.
Selection and interviews will be conducted continuously. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.
Background checks and pre-employment medical examinations form part of our recruitment process.
For further information, please contact:
Jonas Bessing
Head of Recruitment
+46 (0)736-264750 or at jbe@oddab.eu.
Join Oresund DryDocks and become a key contributor to the continued success and development of Sweden's leading shipyard for repair and conversion projects.

jobs.occupation: CEO for a pioneering technology company
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on creating business value, leading people and bringing pioneering technology to market? Would you like to spearhead a company developing innovative solutions for growing international markets?
Our client is looking for a CEO to lead its next phase, working closely with the engineers and scientists behind the company's technology. You will develop the business, bring the organisation together around clear priorities and build the international relationships that turn technical progress into commercial opportunities.
This is an opportunity to lead the commercialization of proprietary technology, combining the expertise of a highly qualified technical team with your own ability to build an international business.
Does this sound like the opportunity for you? Read on.

About the role
As CEO, you will lead and develop the company across its two business areas. You will shape the business strategy with the board and take responsibility for its execution within the agreed budget, translating it into priorities and shared goals.
You will act on and create business opportunities and personally drive key commercial relationships and negotiations. Working closely with the technical leadership, CFO/COO and board, you will unite customer needs, technical capabilities and financial priorities.
The role calls for commercial judgement and enough technical understanding to work confidently with customers, partners and specialists. You will draw on the expertise within the organisation while taking responsibility for decisions, direction and progress.
The company is based in Gothenburg, Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence with the team and international travel.

In this role you will

Develop and execute the commercial direction in alignment with the board, focusing on markets and opportunities with the strongest commercial potential.

Use and develop your international network to build relationships with industrial customers and partners.

Personally drive complex business opportunities from initial dialogue through negotiation to agreement.

Build internal structures, with clear responsibilities, decision-making and follow-up.

Lead the organisation towards shared goals, aligning technical development and resources with business priorities.

Prioritize resources towards the most attractive opportunities within the agreed budget, taking responsibility for cash flow and funding planning together with the CFO/COO and board.

Communicate progress, opportunities and risks clearly to employees, the board and investors.

Build relationships with investors and lead capital raising initiatives.

To succeed in this role you will bring

Experience leading and developing a technology-intensive business, business unit or commercial function, with responsibility for people, resources and financial results.

The ability to turn strategic goals into clear priorities, effective ways of working and measurable progress.

A hands-on approach with the ability to deliver results in a small organization with limited resources.

A proven record of personally developing and closing complex international B2B technology agreements with industrial customers.

A relevant international industry network and experience bringing new technology to market, including customer testing, qualification or development partnerships.

Solid technical understanding and commercial experience from technology-driven markets such as advanced electronics, materials, energy technology, industrial technology or related fields.

A relevant educational background in technology or business, or equivalent professional experience, excellent English and the ability to travel internationally.

Additional experience we value
Previous CEO responsibility, capital raising and experience in a listed company is valuable. Experience in industrial automation, telecommunications, sensor technology or advanced manufacturing may also be relevant where it includes comparable commercialisation and industrial business development.

Personal qualities
You are a clear and approachable leader who takes responsibility for the whole business. You listen to the expertise around you, make considered decisions and explain the priorities behind them. You enjoy creating opportunities and stay involved in the work needed to move them forward. When conditions change or the way ahead is uncertain, you maintain focus, adapt your approach and keep people informed. You build trust through realistic expectations and consistent follow-through.

Application and contact
Do you recognize yourself in this description? We would love to hear from you!
Please send us your application, we look forward to meeting you.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, so do not wait to apply.

jobs.occupation: Join our Backend Team in Gothenburg
jobs.description:
TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
We’re looking for experienced Backend Developers in Gothenburg who combine strong technical skills with ownership, curiosity and a genuine drive to move things forward.
What you’ll be working with
You’ll join a development team at one of our clients, building and operating modern backend services and cloud-based platforms for connected products and digital services.
The exact technology stack will vary by assignment. It may include Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go, together with AWS and/or Azure. Some teams focus on customer-facing backend services, while others develop cloud platforms, integrations and developer tools.
You’ll work in a collaborative, DevOps-oriented environment and contribute throughout the service lifecycle, from design and development to deployment, monitoring, operations and continuous improvement.
Your work may include
Developing and maintaining backend services using Java, C#/.NET, Python and/or Go
Designing and building cloud-native solutions on AWS or Azure
Building REST APIs, microservices and integrations
Working with event-driven systems and distributed architectures
Using cloud services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and SQS
Working with containers and Kubernetes, depending on the team
Improving CI/CD, automation, monitoring, logging and service reliability
Contributing to code reviews, technical discussions and architecture decisions

Skills & qualifications
We’re looking for someone with:
At least 5 years of professional backend development experience
Strong experience in at least one of the following: Java, C#/.NET, Python or Go.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure
Experience building and operating APIs, services or distributed systems
A good understanding of software quality, reliability and maintainability
Fluent written and spoken English
A BSc or MSc in Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good to have
AWS serverless experience, such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB or SQS
Experience with Azure services
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications
CI/CD and DevOps practices
Event-driven architecture or tools such as Kafka
Experience in connected services, IoT, automotive or telecom
Fluent written and spoken Swedish

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer – Dog Transportation in Car
jobs.description:
Bring your life
Are you passionate about developing products where safety, engineering excellence, and user experience come together? Do you want to help create innovative solutions that allow people and their dogs to travel safely and comfortably together?
As part of our Dog Transportation category, you'll contribute to solutions that combine thoughtful design, engineering excellence, and industry-leading safety. With an exciting product portfolio and roadmap ahead, you'll help shape dog transportation solutions that make adventures with dogs safer, easier, and more enjoyable.
 
What you'll do at Thule
As a Mechanical Design Engineer - Dog Transportation in Car, you'll be part of our committed engineering team developing innovative dog transportation solutions for vehicles, including dog crates and related products. Together, we take ideas from concept to finished product through a structured and collaborative development process.
In this role, you will design and develop components in CAD, create high-quality technical specifications, and collaborate closely with project managers, simulation and test engineers, and prototype specialists to solve technical challenges and ensure every detail meets the high standards and requirements of the automotive industry.
You will take an active role in ordering and evaluating prototypes, analyzing test results, and using simulations to verify the strength and performance of your designs.
In addition, you will document technical solutions, manage design-related risks, and contribute to engineering best practices. Leading and supporting design reviews will be an important part of your role, helping ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability.
 
What you bring
To succeed in this role, we believe you have a university degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, combined with some years of experience in mechanical design and product development.
You have worked with a variety of materials and understand how to optimize designs for functionality, durability, and safety. Experience from consumer products, automotive products, or other safety-critical applications is highly valuable. You are fluent in both Swedish and English.
As the role includes practical elements, we believe you thrive in a hands-on product development environment. As a person, you are self-driven, structured, and solution-oriented, with the ability to turn ideas into robust and well-engineered products. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines and can effectively manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
 
Why you should join Thule
At Thule, we are Proud to Be Thule. We believe anything is possible when we stay curious, take initiative and challenge ourselves. We encourage everyone to take ownership and make the most of their part of the business.
We believe we win as a team by collaborating across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting one another. United by our passion for our products, the outdoors and the Thule brand, we take pride in what we do and create a culture where everyone contributes, grows and has fun.
 
Hiring Process
Apply by submitting your application and resumé through “Apply for position” on our Thule Career Site. The application deadline is November 22, 2026.
Please make sure to not wait to show your interest until the last application date as interviews are held continuously during the process, and the position might be filled before the last application date. Please also note that we do not accept applications by e-mail.
If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Oscar Persson, at Oscar.persson@thule.com
We look forward to hearing from you!
Thule is a global sports and outdoor company. We offer high-quality products with smart features and a sustainable design that make it easy for people across the globe to live an active life. Under the motto Bring your life — and with a focus on consumer-driven innovation and long-term sustainability — we develop, manufacture and market products within the product categories Sport & Cargo Carriers (roof racks, roof boxes and carriers for transporting cycling, water and winter sports equipment, and rooftop tents mounted on a car), Active with Kids & Dogs (car seats, strollers, bike trailers, child bike seats and dog transport), RV Products (awnings, bike carriers and tents for RVs and caravans) and Bags & Mounts (backpacks, luggage and performance mounts).
Thule Group has about 3,000 employees at nine production facilities and 35 sales offices worldwide. The Group’s products are sold in 138 markets and in 2025, sales amounted to SEK 10,4 billion.
www.thulegroup.com

The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

jobs.occupation: Line Manager for Dynamic Control Design
jobs.description:

The Dynamic Control Design team in Ludvika, Sweden is seeking a manager to take on the role as leader to support and develop the individuals, the group, and the team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the team that is responsible for the overall performance of HVDC transmission links, focusing on the dynamic control design.
As the Line Manager for Dynamic Control Design, you will have personnel responsibility for a team of approximately 15-20 professionals reporting to you. You will be tasked with ensuring that the team is adequately resourced, developed, and equipped to meet business needs, as well as ensuring that the company's culture and values are reflected in all employee practices and policies. Your primary objective will be to motivate and engage your team and to support them to achieve their full potential, while ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations.

We believe everything can be improved and it is vital that you have a positive mindset to a learning organization that is continuously improving its knowledge, methods, and skills." - Hiring Manager Magnus Öhrström.

Building and developing the team and the individuals in it by managing recruitment of new members, employee training and development initiatives, as well as providing strategic direction, leadership, and coordination of the function.
Contribute to the HVDC System Performance Management team and collaborate with other managers in the organization related to system studies.
Planning for project staffing and adjusting it according to business needs, as well as planning for both short-term and more strategic long-term changes in the team structure.
Develop the processes and tools within your team.
Preparing annual budget and manage within budget and resource constraints.
Take part of the entire design process from technology development, marketing support & tender work to final design and verification in HVDC projects.

Solid experience in HVDC technology and system performance studies, with a minimum of five years of leadership experience in a people management role or a comparable leadership position, such as Project Manager.

jobs.description:
In this role you will be part of a new expanding department that will focus on type testing and type approvals within HVDC for Electrical Environment. We are part of Control & Protection for hardware design. We are designing the automation system layout with placement of circuit boards and cable channeling and more, at our sites. Our cubicles have control cabinet layout, consisting of hundreds of circuit boards for measurements, control and calculations. Our system also includes user interfaces such as HMI (Human Machine Interface), diagnostic tools and IT infrastructure and IT security. For this we utilize our in-house developed real-time platform MACH to meet the power industry’s standards.
In this position you will have a bigger scope than the actual testing. You will be part of requirements, standards, test setups, evaluating test results and be included in the actual testing. We offer an exciting and stimulating work environment in a growing business where you will be part of delivering technologies in world class. Experience of working with standards and requirements in business environment, such as IEC and IEEE.
Knowledge within EMC, climatic tests, mechanical tests and safety.

Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!
Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.

Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.

jobs.occupation: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control – Expert
Integro Consulting | Automotive & Powertrain Development | Sweden
Help shape the future of sustainable powertrain technology
Integro Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Senior Expert in Embedded Software Architecture and Spark-Ignited Internal Combustion Engine (SI ICE) Control for a consulting assignment with our client, Volvo Trucks.
This is an opportunity to contribute to next-generation powertrain technologies, particularly hydrogen-powered combustion engines and alternative fuels for heavy-duty applications.
Combining expertise in embedded software, model-based control, and engine management with technical leadership, you will help develop advanced control systems, automate engineering workflows, and explore the potential of physics-inspired AI and machine learning.
About the assignment
You will contribute to early-phase development and concept engineering within a multidisciplinary powertrain organisation. Your primary focus will be embedded software architecture and model-based control systems for spark-ignited engines, particularly hydrogen internal combustion engines (H2 ICE).
You will work across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable control solutions while improving software development, testing, verification, and calibration through automation. You will also investigate how physics-inspired AI/ML can enhance modelling, diagnostics, control strategies, and engineering optimisation.
Key responsibilities
Embedded software architecture: Define scalable architectures and control concepts for SI ICE applications, particularly hydrogen engines.

Engine control: Develop and integrate ECU functions for air-path management, torque modelling, combustion control, knock detection, and knock control.

Model-based development: Translate system requirements into control models, software implementations, and verified solutions.

Software integration: Integrate ECU functions with sensors, actuators, diagnostics, communication interfaces, and powertrain platforms.

Automation: Improve software development, code generation, continuous integration, testing, and verification workflows.

Calibration optimisation: Automate calibration processes, measurement-data analysis, test planning, and optimisation.

Physics-inspired AI/ML: Explore physics-based and data-driven methods for modelling, control, diagnostics, and optimisation.

Testing and verification: Support SIL/HIL testing, engine test-bench activities, calibration, and release-readiness assessments.

Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, coordinate engineering activities, provide technical recommendations, and share knowledge.

Required qualifications and experience
We are looking for a senior technical expert who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.
You should have:
An M.Sc., PhD, or equivalent expertise in control engineering, mechatronics, electronics, automation, applied physics, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in powertrain development, embedded systems, or automotive product development.

Extensive experience in model-based control for spark-ignited combustion engines, including requirements, modelling, implementation, integration, verification, and calibration.

Deep knowledge of ECU function development, air-path control, torque modelling, combustion control, and knock detection and control.

Strong experience in embedded software architecture, AUTOSAR Classic, software integration, diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols.

Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity, including ISO 26262 and SAE J21434.

Experience with SIL/HIL testing, engine test benches, data analysis, and technical documentation.

Practical experience in automated software development, code generation, scripting, continuous integration, and automated testing.

Experience in ECU calibration and optimisation, including test planning and measurement-data processing.

Advanced working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and Python.

Experience with ATI Vision and/or AVL Concerto. Knowledge of ETAS INCA, ETAS ASCMO, TargetLink, and C/C++ is also relevant.

Strong technical leadership, analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English.

You are proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to challenge established approaches constructively and collaborate across engineering disciplines.
Meritorious experience
The following would be particularly valuable:
Development or calibration of hydrogen, natural gas, or other alternative-fuel SI engines, especially for heavy-duty applications.

Experience with physics-inspired AI/ML, physics-informed learning, hybrid modelling, virtual sensing, anomaly detection, or data-driven control.

Applying AI/ML to improve engineering workflows, software development, testing, or calibration.

Knowledge of software-defined vehicle architectures, AUTOSAR Adaptive, or RTOS-based solutions.

Experience in heavy-duty powertrain development, calibration, verification tools, or engineering methods.

Contributions to technical roadmaps, patents, scientific publications, or engineering competence development.

Interested in this opportunity?
If you have the expertise to advance embedded engine control and sustainable powertrain technology, we would like to hear from you.
Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your relevant experience, highlighting your expertise in embedded software architecture, SI ICE control, model-based development, ECU calibration, and automation.
Please also include your availability and any experience with hydrogen engines or physics-inspired AI/ML.
Apply through Integro Consulting to discuss the assignment and how you can contribute to this exciting development programme.

We are looking for a Process Assistant Engineer to join our Sweden factory and support the daily management, optimisation and continuous improvement of our separator coating processes.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. The manufacturing process consists of four main process steps, where precision, stability and quality are essential.
Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
As a Process Assistant Engineer, you will support the daily operation and continuous improvement of our slurry, coating and slitting processes. You will work with production and process data, assist in troubleshooting and process validation, and contribute to improving process stability, product quality and production efficiency.
The role is hands-on and cross-functional, giving you the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams while developing your technical and analytical skills in a modern manufacturing environment.
Job Responsibilities
Assist in the daily maintenance and optimisation of separator coating processes, including slurry, coating and slitting parameters and other key process conditions.

Provide technical support to Production and assist in troubleshooting issues related to process parameters, materials and other process abnormalities.

Collect, organise and analyse production data and key process parameters, identify abnormal trends and support continuous process improvement.

Assist in process validation and DOE trials, evaluate the impact of parameters on process and product performance, and support optimisation of the process window.

Participate in internal and customer quality investigations using methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram and FTA.

Assist in developing PDCA actions and verifying their effectiveness.

Support new product trials, new slurry and raw material validation, and process condition verification.

Follow up on trial production and analyse relevant process and quality data.

Work with Equipment Engineers to analyse how different equipment functions affect product quality and support equipment and process improvements.

Assist in preparing and maintaining SOPs, process parameter sheets, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports and other process-related documentation.

Cooperate with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams to resolve production issues, improve process stability and continuously improve product quality.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A bachelor's degree in engineering, chemistry, materials science, manufacturing or another relevant field.

At least 1 year of relevant industrial or manufacturing experience.

A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.

An interest in process development, production technology and continuous improvement.

Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions.

The ability to analyse data, identify trends and support fact-based technical decisions.

A hands-on approach and the ability to work in a production environment.

Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, in an international working environment.

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have
Experience from coating, slitting, slurry preparation or other continuous manufacturing processes.

Experience with process validation, DOE or statistical process analysis.

Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, FTA or PDCA.

Experience working with production, quality or process data.

Experience from the battery, automotive, chemical, materials or other advanced manufacturing industries.

Familiarity with technical documentation, SOPs and process specifications.

What You Can Expect
You will join an international industrial organisation where process engineering plays an important role in ensuring stable production, high product quality and continuous improvement.
The role offers hands-on experience with advanced manufacturing processes and the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams.
You will have the opportunity to develop your technical and analytical skills while contributing to the optimisation of processes that support the production of separator film for the next generation of lithium-ion batteries.
We value responsibility, collaboration, continuous learning and straightforward communication. Different perspectives are important to us, and we encourage an open and respectful working environment.

jobs.occupation: Finnish radiographers wanted for opportunity in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a qualified radiographer from Finland interested in taking the next step in your career in Sweden?
We are currently recruiting two Finnish radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in a coastal community in central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance. The position offers daytime working hours only, with no evenings, nights, weekends, public holidays or on-call duties.
The department
You will become part of a smaller radiology department with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with modern equipment, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, giving you the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in an environment with a higher acute patient flow.
About the role
Your main work will be within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00.
There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous professional experience as a radiographer is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience in CT and conventional radiography is particularly valuable.
Requirements
We are looking for candidates who:
Hold a radiographer qualification from Finland
Have the legal right to practise as a radiographer in Finland
Are currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Are interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Have good communication skills in English
Are motivated to learn Swedish
Are interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

Meritorious
Previous experience in CT
Previous experience in conventional radiography
Knowledge of Swedish
Swedish professional authorization

The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area offers a combination of small-town living and easy access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to someone looking for a quieter lifestyle, short distances and good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
Schools and childcare are available locally, with good transport connections to larger cities.
Swedish language training and relocation
If you do not already speak Swedish at the required level, Swedish language training is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin studying Swedish from Finland through individual online lessons with a private teacher while continuing your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After relocating, you initially work 50% as a Radiography Assistant while continuing your Swedish studies from 
B2 to C1. During this period, work takes place in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
Once you have reached the required Swedish level and obtained Swedish professional authorization, you begin working fully as a radiographer.
Salary
During the language completion phase in Sweden, while employed as a Radiography Assistant, 
the salary is: 30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and starting work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is: 31,100 SEK/month gross
For radiographers with previous professional experience, the salary may be individually determined based on experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during and after your relocation and employment
Assistance with the process of obtaining Swedish professional authorization
Help with relocation and accommodation
Support for your family if needed
Free Swedish language training with a private online tutor

Interested in working as a radiographer in Sweden?
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Help Shape the Future of Sustainable Food

At Lantmännen Biorefineries, we develop sustainable ingredients from oats, wheat, and peas that help shape the future of food. As an Application Specialist, you will apply your expertise in ingredient functionality and food systems to develop food applications that demonstrate the full potential of our ingredient portfolio. Combining scientific expertise, creativity, and a hands-on approach, you will turn ideas into practical applications that create value for customers and support business growth. This is a temporary position covering parental leave, with the possibility of extension

This is what you will do

You will be the technical expert connecting our ingredients with real-world food applications.

Your responsibilities include:

Developing and optimizing applications for existing and new food ingredients.
Designing and conducting trials to evaluate product functionality and performance.
Supporting customer projects through technical guidance, demonstrations, and troubleshooting.
Leading application-related projects from concept through prototyping and commercialization.
Evaluating analytical results and translating insights into product recommendations.
Identifying new opportunities through customer feedback, market insights, and emerging food trends.
Collaborating with Sales, Product Development, Production, and Quality teams to deliver successful solutions.
Ensuring compliance with food safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.

This is what you need to succeed

You have:

BSc or MSc in Food Science or Food Technology. We also welcome candidates with substantial hands-on experience in food application development, and deep expertise in ingredient functionality and food systems, especially within the field of dairy and meat analogues.
Experience in application development, product development, technical service, or food ingredient innovation.
Knowledge of food ingredients, functionality, and food processing.
R&D project management capabilities.
Knowledge of GMP, quality systems, and laboratory practices.
Excellent communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage.

You are:

You combine a strong scientific mindset with practical food application expertise. Whether your expertise has been gained through formal education or hands-on experience, you understand the relationship between food ingredients, processing, structure, texture, and product performance. You can translate this knowledge into food products with the right texture, stability, and eating experience. You are systematic and analytical, while remaining practical and results-oriented in your approach. You use logical thinking and sound judgement to solve problems and drive projects forward efficiently. You are curious and open-minded, yet grounded and pragmatic You balance technical depth with practical execution, delivering results effectively without waiting for every detail to be fully understood

You share our values - Openness, Holistic view, Drive - and our promise of taking responsibility from Field to Fork.

What we offer you

At Lantmännen, sustainability, innovation, and long-term thinking are at the heart of everything we do. We offer an opportunity to work with industry-leading ingredients, contribute to the future of food, and grow within an international group that is continuously investing in innovation and people development.

That is how we make it matter, from field to fork.

Sounds interesting? 

We hope so! You can apply for the position online by attaching your CV or LinkedIn profile. To ensure a more objective and inclusive recruitment process, we ask you to answer a number of screening questions as part of your application instead of submitting a cover letter.

The recruitment process includes assessments and competency-based interviews. For the final candidate, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing will be conducted.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Lantmännen is an agricultural cooperative and Northern Europe’s leader in agriculture, bioenergy and food products. Owned by 17,000 Swedish farmers, Lantmännen has more than 10,000 employees, operations in over 20 countries and an annual turnover of SEK 60 billion. With grain at the heart of the operations, Lantmännen refine arable land resources to make farming thrive. Some of Lantmännen’s best-known food brands are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, GoGreen, FINN CRISP, Schulstad and Vaasan. The company is founded on the knowledge and values acquired through generations of farmers. By engaging in research, development and operations throughout the value chain, Lantmännen takes responsibility from field to fork.

Lantmännen Biorefineries is the only large scale producer and supplier of grain-based fuel ethanol in Sweden and is owned by Lantmännen. The company offers attractive, profitable and sustainable protein, ethanol and carbon dioxide products that are produced in a responsible way. The plants are located in Norrköping and Lidköping. Biorefineries has approximately 300 co-workers and an annual turnover of almost SEK 4,5 billion.

More about Lantmännen

jobs.occupation: Volvo Group Graduate Program 2027 - Associate Project & Commodity Buyer
jobs.description:
Company description:This is the Volvo Group Graduate Program
The 15-month Graduate Program combines 50% time in your home department with 50% dedicated program activities, giving you broad exposure across Volvo Group. Through local and international rotations, short-term assignments, and targeted training in areas such as operations, engineering, and purchasing, you will build a strong understanding of our business, brands and strategy. 
Job description:Your future team 
The ECU Purchasing team buys the Electronic Control Units used in vehicles, powertrains, and gearboxes. The team works with suppliers and internal teams such as engineering, quality, projects, and supply chain to select the right solutions, agree competitive prices, follow supplier performance, support projects, reduce costs, and manage risks such as component shortages or obsolete technology.
 How you’ll contribute  
You will be supporting the development and execution of ECU sourcing strategies, securing competitive cost, quality, delivery, innovation, and supply resilience through effective supplier and stakeholder collaboration.
 Key responsibilities:  
  Help prepare ECU sourcing strategies by collecting information about market trends, new technologies, business needs, and potential suppliers.  
 Support supplier selection by preparing requests for quotation, comparing offers, participating in negotiations, and summarizing recommendations for review.  
 Follow supplier performance in areas such as cost, quality, delivery, innovation, sustainability, and supply continuity, and help coordinate actions when improvements are needed.  
 Assist with purchasing activities during the ECU product lifecycle, including development changes, cost-saving opportunities, contract follow-up, and commercial issue resolution.  
 Help identify purchasing and supply risks, support the preparation of mitigation actions, follow their progress, and raise important issues to the team.  
 Keep purchasing data, contracts, supplier information, sourcing documents, and reports accurately and up to date.
  Who are you? 
We are looking for someone with a strong transformation and collaborative mindset who is eager to learn, explore, and understand the business. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new challenges and ambiguity, and take ownership of your own development and growth. With strong analytical skills, you take initiatives and drive tasks forward with determination while bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the team. 
 You enjoy building relationships and leveraging a global network to create impact while working collaboratively across teams and functions. You also have a passion for Electronics and Business! 
 You meet the following requirements: 
  You have a degree in Master of Technology (M.Tech) or equivalent relevant master’s degree 
 Experience in data analysis, data science, or predictive modelling  
 Project planning and delivery  
 Business requirements analysis and solution design  
 Industrial, logistics, or supply-chain understanding is beneficial  
 Interest in working in global organizations and collaborating across functions, cultures and locations  
  
Experience may come from academic projects, internships, thesis work, or early professional assignments 
 Additional desirable skills:  
  Specialisation in supply chain and electronics engineering  
  
 
 To qualify for the Graduate program, you: 
  Have completed a Master’s degree prior to the start of the program but not more than 3 years ago.  
 Should not have more than three years' full-time relevant working experience in the field prior to starting the program, excluding part-time work during studies.  
 Are fluent in English, both written and verbal.   
 Are willing to travel and participate in international short-term assignments 
  What’s in it for you? 
Our Volvo Group Graduate Program starts in August 2027, and you will be offered a permanent position at FSDV Purchasing department with placement in Sweden, Gothenburg. These are some of the benefits of joining our program: 
  An opportunity to work with the latest technology. 
 An exciting and global working environment with experienced colleagues. 
 Possibility to gain international experience through a short-term assignment abroad. 
 A competitive salary and permanent position from day one. 
 Various workshops and seminars designed to help you grow into your future career at Volvo Group. 
 The possibility to shape your own career with endless career opportunities. 
  
 Read more about the Graduate program here
 The application process 
 The journey begins! An email confirmation will be sent when you submit your application. After this, it is still possible to update your personal profile by logging into your account. The hiring team will review your application together with the hiring manager. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with information about the following steps.  
 Last day to apply: 22nd of November 2026  
  As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. 
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
